title: cast it on Him

verses.text: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you.
Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.

caption:
You do not have to carry the weight alone today.

Peter wrote this to people under real pressure, and he did not tell them to be stronger. He told them to hand it over, because the One holding them cares. The waiting is not wasted, and the restoring is His work, not ours.

1 Peter 5:6, 5:7 and 5:10 (BSB)
